description: DeepWorkPlan ecosystem hub: the public repositories scripts/repositories.sh clones into repositories/<name>. Every clone is git-ignored; only this manifest and README.md are tracked.

repositories.name: deepworkplan-skill
repositories.summary: The DeepWorkPlan methodology packaged as an installable agent skill (the source of truth for the spec and kit).

repositories.name: herdr-peers
repositories.summary: Ask an agent in another Herdr pane, on any machine, and get one authorized reply (the herdr addon).

repositories.name: coding-agents-kit
repositories.summary: One ak command for every terminal coding agent: accounts, quota, ak pick and headless runs (the agentkit addon).

repositories.name: devcontainer-kit
repositories.summary: A reproducible dev container per repository, rendered from one template and wired to Herdr and the host accounts (the devcontainer addon).

repositories.name: deepworkplan-vim
repositories.summary: DeepWorkPlan Vim: the terminal editor for plans, with a plan browser, a lanes view and a Markdown viewer (the vim addon).

repositories.name: ai-diff-reviewer
repositories.summary: AI Diff Reviewer: the local and CI pull-request reviewer behind the Ready label.

repositories.name: agent-skill
repositories.shared_with: Also owned by the Dailybot hub: pull before editing and never keep unpushed work here, so the two hubs never double-edit.

repositories.name: cli
repositories.summary: The Dailybot CLI: a production repository that dogfoods the full DWP stack (pack, every addon, dck container) as the ecosystem's reference consumer.
repositories.shared_with: Also owned by the Dailybot hub: pull before editing and never keep unpushed work here, so the two hubs never double-edit. Every merge to main auto-releases a CLI version.
